title.narrative: Political Climate Leadership – Denmark and Brazil

description.narrative:
To raise Brazilian legislators’ awareness of the importance of climate leadership in the political agenda and qualify their understanding of sustainable development and climate change - especially in the creation of new sustainability policies and in their decision-making process.
RAPS (Political Action Network for Sustainability) has a strong record of accomplishment and relevant experience working with Brazilian policymakers within the area of climate leadership. The organization represents Brazil’s biggest network of elected officials across the ideological spectre and strongly advocates for cooperation amongst different political parties with a result and action-based focus. Copenhagen University and Professor Katherine Richardson will contribute with a video course production based on cutting edge knowledge and communication skills.
The project will achieve its objective through the realization of: 1) a four-day delegation visit to Denmark for members of congress from RAPS’ network. The goal with the delegation visit is to present successful Danish sustainability policies, climate leadership know-how and to strengthen the dialogue between Brazilian and Danish parliamentarians. 2) A video learning course produced by the University of Copenhagen for a broader target group, including congress, NGOs, academia, with focus on planetary boundaries, energy transition, carbon markets, investment tools and Danish solutions to mitigate climate change phenomena - adapted to a Brazilian context.
